name: Taskboard full-stack app

tools.purpose: Kit checks and local preview helper.

tools.name: docker
tools.requirement: Engine >=28, local daemon and Compose with up --wait/--wait-timeout and build --builder
tools.purpose: Local app and PostgreSQL preview; Node runs inside the app image.

tools.name: node
tools.purpose: Application tests on the host; not needed on the host for Docker preview.

tools.name: npm
tools.purpose: Run npm ci in app before host application tests; the Docker preview installs its own dependencies.

tools.name: terraform
tools.purpose: Infrastructure validation after provider initialization; cloud plans use the existing approval gate.

operating_modes.description: Unauthenticated loopback-only task preview with local PostgreSQL on Linux, macOS or WSL2. Attachments and OCI services are not enabled. This is not production acceptance.
Explicitly allowed client CIDRs and unauthenticated sandbox app. Cloud creation, image publication and cleanup need separate exact approvals.
HTTPS, OIDC, Vault, private app networking and ownership checks. Requires configured prerequisites and live security/recovery evidence before real users.

acceptance.description: Record the source revision, local task create/update/delete result and application test output.
Retain private readiness evidence, exact approved saved plan and dated cost basis; metadata validity proves none of these.
Verify the actual HTTPS endpoint, OIDC login, two-user isolation, CSRF rejection and authenticated upload/download bytes.
Record restore/rollback checks, retention decisions, approved cleanup and residual-resource verification.
